goal: Generate verified frontier-of-capability tasks without contaminating release benchmarks or rewarding unverifiable self-judgment.

roles.challenger: Propose diverse tasks near but not beyond the solver's learnable frontier.
roles.solver: Solve tasks under the same tool/authority policy used by AQLEVON training environments.
roles.verifier: Deterministic or evidence-grounded judge independent of challenger and solver text claims.

difficulty_control.target_band: tasks should be neither trivial nor impossible for the current solver
difficulty_control.promote_band_when: stable solver success exceeds the configured upper threshold on private curriculum-dev tasks
difficulty_control.decrease_band_when: solver success collapses or verifier rejection rises
